## About

GeoSIRR—Geological Section Interpretation, Reconstruction & Refinement—is a Python application that translates geological narratives into a domain-specific language and coordinate-based cross-sections [@anikiev2026geosirr]. Users can generate, validate, visualize, refine, and query a section through a command-line conversation.

## Why it matters

Turning an informal geological description into consistent geometry is slow and requires both domain and drafting expertise. GeoSIRR makes the intermediate representation explicit: the generated geometry can be inspected, validated, revised, and reproduced rather than remaining hidden in an image-generation system.

## Key capabilities and audience

GeoSIRR combines completeness checks, format and topology validation, Matplotlib visualization, iterative refinement, and section-aware question answering. It is designed for geologists, educators, subsurface modelers, and researchers evaluating large language models in scientific workflows.
